subsetPolicyRationale: `s.trinity.rewriting@1` is this plugin's own self-contained code-rewriting document — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (edit-before-fixture, edit-lhs, edit-rhs, change-parameter-binding, remove-parameter-binding, change-rule-layout-point, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
